questions.stem: A tangent to a circle meets the radius at the point of contact at an angle of:
questions.explanation: A tangent to a circle is always perpendicular to the radius at the point of tangency, forming a $90°$ angle.

questions.stem: A circle has a radius of $7\text{ cm}$. What is the length of its diameter?
questions.explanation: The diameter is twice the radius: $d = 2r = 2 \times 7 = 14\text{ cm}$.

questions.stem: Which part of a circle is a 'pizza slice' shape bounded by two radii and an arc?
questions.explanation: A sector is the region enclosed by two radii and the arc between them, resembling a pizza slice.
